title: Delay rate per airline
statementMd:
For each airline show the percentage of its flights that were delayed or cancelled, rounded to 1 decimal. Highest first (ties by name).

Expected columns: `name`, `disrupted_pct`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.status <> 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS disrupted_pct FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON a.code = f.airline_code GROUP BY a.code, a.name ORDER BY disrupted_pct DESC, a.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
